name: Wallhack1.8k
summary: Open raw WiFi packet and spectrogram dataset for presence and activity recognition in line-of-sight and through-wall settings.

hardware.platform: Two WiFi systems with BQ and PIFA antennas

settings.scenario: LoS and NLoS/through-wall; no presence, walking, walking plus arm waving

collection.device: ESP32-S3 CSI (BQ biquad + PIFA antenna systems)
collection.subjects: Not reported as subject IDs (single-person activity recordings)
collection.scenario_labels: NLoS room: 0 = none; 1–5 = room index · LoS / NLoS hallway and through-wall paths
collection.subcarrier_spacing: 312.5 kHz (standard 20 MHz OFDM L-LTF; inferred, not stored in release)
collection.scenario: LoS hallway path and through-wall NLoS across adjacent offices

original.license: Open Zenodo record; verify file license metadata

standardization.notes: Activity uses the 100 Hz time rule. Keep 52 subcarriers, 1 Tx, and 1 Rx; output is [T, S, Tx, Rx] per sample.
